Subject: Quick follow-up — propose three 12-minute options for technical deep dive

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate you walking through the high-level goals for Voltai Systems. Based on what we discussed, the most useful next step is a tight technical deep dive focused on inference latency & cost targets, integration touchpoints (KV cache, routing), and a quick demo of our batching behavior.

I know calendars are tight after your last-minute conflict; to make scheduling simple I can offer three short, focused windows (12 minutes each) so your engineering lead can hop on without a big block:

- Option A: Tue Sep 23 — 09:00–09:12 PT
- Option B: Tue Sep 23 — 11:30–11:42 PT
- Option C: Wed Sep 24 — 08:15–08:27 PT

Please reply with a single letter (A/B/C) that you can commit to — I’ll lock the invite and have Marissa (solutions engineer) join. If none of those work, please propose one strict 12-minute slot (we’ll prioritize it for Voltai).

I attached a one-pager agenda and will include a calendar stub once you confirm the slot. If you prefer a longer 30-minute session, say so and we’ll schedule separately, but given your team’s availability the short option helps us get into the technical details quickly.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Rishi Malhotra | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
